title: Going back to Brita
text: Going back to Brita. The lid never fit right so it kept falling.  Now it's unusable. I thought I give this one a try after being a Brita person for years.  Nope, it sucks.

product_metadata.title: PUR Water Filter Pitcher Filtration System, 7 Cup, Clear/Blue
features: WATER FILTRATION SYSTEM – Quickly and easily enjoy refreshing, filtered water in your fridge with the PUR 7 Cup Water Filter Pitcher. With the help of PUR, you can enjoy cleaner, great-tasting drinking water.
REDUCES CONTAMINANTSƚ – PUR Pitcher Filtration System contains PUR filter PPF900Z, which is certified to reduce 2X more contaminants than Brita’s leading pitcher filter.

EASY TO USE – This BPA-free water filter pitcher is dishwasher safe and features a slim, space-saving design that fits in most refrigerator doors. The stay-tight lid allows you to pour while water is filtering and prevent spills.

COMPATIBLE DOES NOT MEAN COMPARABLE – Genuine PUR pitcher filters are certified to reduce harmful contaminants from your water. Genuine PUR Filters are the only filters certified for use in PUR systems.

A BRAND YOU CAN TRUST – Contaminants can enter your water system daily, so filtering your water is important. PUR has been developing innovative technologies for superior water filtration for over 30 years.
description: The PUR 7 Cup Water Filter Pitcher offers refreshing water quickly and easily. Each PUR water filter is certified to reduce mercury and certain industrial pollutants, as well as reducing chlorine (taste and odor) and more. The filter lasts up to 2 months and gives you 40 gallons (or 640 8oz cups) of great-tasting water. PUR’s superior filter technology uses activated carbon and ion exchange media and is certified to reduce 2x more contaminants than Brita’s leading water pitcher filter. The PUR filtered water pitcher has a slim, space-saving design that fits easily in the fridge, while the comfort-grip handle and easy-fill lid make it easy to use. A water filtration system is important because tap water may look clean but can contain potentially harmful contaminants from pipes. Compatible water filter replacements are not certified to offer the same water quality – genuine PUR Filters are the only filters certified for use in PUR systems. Using a PUR water filter system can save up to $1,000 per year on average compared with the cost of bottled water** and help keep plastic bottle waste out of landfills. Each replacement water filter provides 40 gallons of filtered water or up to 2 months of typical use. PUR has been developing innovative technologies for superior water filtration for over 30 years. We believe life deserves PUR water. Disclaimers: PUR does not filter microbes.*Versus best-selling Brita® pitcher filter OB03. Brita® is a trademark of Brita LP.**Based on comparing a year's worth of bottled water (16.9 oz) to a PUR Dispenser a year's worth of 9 refills. Based on Nielsen US Scantrack sales.
